# Knit

> > Knit provides unified APIs for integrating with HR, ATS, CRM, Ticketing, and Accounting platforms through a single integration layer.

Knit simplifies SaaS integrations by offering unified APIs that connect to multiple platforms including Paycom, QuickBooks, Brevo, ServiceNow, and dozens of HRIS, ATS, and CRM systems. The platform enables developers to build once and integrate with hundreds of business applications using standardized data models and endpoints.

## Key Topics

- Unified API
- ATS (Applicant Tracking System)
- HRIS Integration
- CRM API
- Ticketing API
- Accounting API
- API Integration
- Employee Data Sync
- OAuth Authentication
- Schema Management
- Python Integration
- SaaS Connectors
- Data Models
- API Lifecycle Management
